column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4 Baal's city / residents and shops
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Aaargh! I'm starving! Feed me something!!
This city is a fine place! More than anything, the food is delicious!!
The ruler of this city is Lord $$バアル$$!!
He is a very wicked but pleasant gentleman, and I have even been invited to dine with him!
Armor!? Never heard of it...
I know truffles, but those are food, aren't they?!
What? Black $$羽$$ women? You can find plenty of them around here, can't you?
You hardly ever see white $$羽$$ $$奴隷$$s in this city, right?!
When the people of this city run out of money, they offer their own $$奴隷$$s to Lord $$バアル$$...
and receive food in return...!
But I have no money and no $$奴隷$$ left to offer, so I cannot get any food!!
You're far too white...
Woof, woof!
Shoo, shoo!!
This is no place for $$奴隷$$s like you!!
Yes, the black $$羽$$ people in this city do not work; they hardly even try to move!
So I deliver food to the people in town every day!
I hear the other white $$羽$$ $$奴隷$$s work at Lord $$バアル$$'s estate, but...
no one knows what they do there.
Because not a single $$奴隷$$ has ever returned from the estate!
But Lord $$バアル$$ is a wicked man! He even speaks kind words to us $$奴隷$$s...
And food is delivered from Lord $$バアル$$ once every week!
Please come again!
J-just one bite for me...
What, a customer?! It is rare for someone to come all this way on foot!
Ha!!
From that look in your eye, I can tell you are quite the gourmet!
The food in this city is exceptionally good!!
How about sampling some right here?!
Try a sample?!
Do not try a sample!!
Th-this is?!
Rich yet light, with not the slightest cloying aftertaste...
Then a delicate, chewy texture spread throughout my mouth...
followed by an intense freshness like light snow across my tongue, leaving only the sweet, luxuriant savor of meat...
It was, in a word, exceptional!!
Would you like another serving?!
Have another serving!
No, thank you!!
Th-this is?!
Though I had just eaten, a crisp, deep five-part harmony of aromas drifted past my nose...
driving my appetite to its limit, while its springy, rich, refined texture met the tender...
flavor of the meat, grounding it firmly and drawing my heart in strangely...
Then its indescribably vivid fragrance magnified both flavors, leaving everything wonderfully juicy...
In any event, it was absurdly delicious!
Hmph!
You have not even sampled the food before you—or tasted it at all—and yet you mean to leave acting like you know it all...
For all your posing as a gourmet, you are merely a pauper!!
Hey, make sure you leave payment for what you ate!
Thaaank you for your patronaaage!!
Y-you bastard!!
Welcome!
This shop stocks only foods brought in from other cities...
items especially suited to preservation!
I care more about goods that keep than goods that taste good!!
Make a heap of money, then eat Lord $$バアル$$'s delicious branded food!
Now then, what will you buy?!
Buying anything else?
You lot!
What business do you have in our gang's territory?!
Yes
No
